en_breve.parrafo: HomeTest is a preventive-health membership based in Madrid, Spain. It combines blood tests covering 110+ biomarkers twice a year, an app that explains the results and connects them with your wearable data, and verified healthcare professionals who help you take action. It does not diagnose or replace your doctor: it helps you understand your health and arrive better prepared at your appointment.
